report: The Impact of the Internet on Institutions in the Future
publisher: Pew Research Center's Internet & American Life Project and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Online cooperation reforms institutions
entries.quote: By 2020, innovative forms of online cooperation will result in significantly more efficient and responsive governments, business, non-profits, and other mainstream institutions.
entries.option_b: By 2020, governments, businesses, non-profits and other mainstream institutions will primarily retain familiar 20th century models for conduct of relationships with citizens and consumers online and offline.
entries.subject: internet and institutional change
entries.note: The report says many who chose the first statement doubted drastic change by 2020.

notes: Tension pair from the Future of the Internet IV survey: respondents chose one of two opposite 2020 statements. quote is the first statement as printed in the report, option_b the second; share_agree is the share choosing quote. Shares are for all 895 respondents; the web report gives no separate expert column. Non-random sample.
